Subject .... Communication dated 14-12-37 from the British Consulate-General
concerning Mr. and Mrs. A. A. Lebedeff.
Made by .... D. S. I. Prokofiev. .... Forwarded by C Crawford. W. J.

Alexander Alexandrovich LEBEDEFF, Russian, was born on
August 25, 1906 at Chita, Transbaikal Province, Siberia. According
to his own statement, he left the U. S. S. R. for China in 1922 in
order to join his father who at that time was employed at the
Chinese Eastern Railway in Harbin. He received his education at
a middle school in Harbin and subsequently studied in the Poly-
technic Institute in that city graduating in 1930. In 1931 he
married Miss M. I. Donetz, daughter of an engineer, a graduate of
the Harbin Law Faculty (Oriental Section) and a teacher of Chi-
nese in a local school of the Chinese Eastern Railway.

Lebedeff arrived in Shanghai from Harbin in August, 1931.
Shortly afterwards he called at the Russian Emigrants' Committee,
118/1 Moulmein Road, and declared that he wished to renounce his
Soviet citizenship and apply for an emigrants' passport. In a
statement he made to the Committee on that occasion he explained
that he had not renounced his Soviet citizenship before because
it would have meant the loss of employment with the Chinese East-
ern Railway to his father and would render it impossible for him
to finish the Polytechnic Institute. He also produced a letter
from Dr. Krivoroochko, local medical practitioner, to the effect
that the latter knew him in Chita and Harbin as a " loyal per-
son who did not belong to any communist organizations". His ap-
plication was granted.

In Shanghai Lebedeff is reported to have been em-
ployed as an assistant engineer with the Mutual Investment Com-
pany for a short period . In 1934-1936 he worked in the same ca-
pacity for G. S. Borisoglebsky, Consulting Structural Engineer.

亚历山大·亚历山德罗维奇·列别杰夫（Alexander Alexandrovich LEBEDEFF），俄国人，1906年8月25日出生于西伯利亚外贝加尔省赤塔。据其自述，他于1922年离开苏联前往中国，以便与其父亲团聚，其父当时受雇于哈尔滨的中东铁路。他在哈尔滨的一所中学接受教育，随后在该市的理工学院学习，于1930年毕业。1931年，他娶了M. I. 多涅茨（Donetz）小姐为妻，后者是一位工程师的女儿，毕业于哈尔滨法学院（东方部），并在当地一所中东铁路学校担任中文教师。

列别杰夫于1931年8月从哈尔滨抵达上海。不久后，他前往莫尔缅路（Moulmein Road）118/1号的俄国侨民委员会，声明希望放弃苏联国籍并申请侨民护照。他在当时向委员会提交的陈述中解释说，他此前未放弃苏联国籍，是因为这将导致其父亲失去在中东铁路的工作，并使他无法完成在理工学院的学业。他还出示了当地执业医师克里沃鲁奇科（Krivoroochko）博士的一封信，信中称后者在赤塔和哈尔滨认识他，认为他是一个“不属于任何共产主义组织的忠诚人士”。他的申请获准。

据报，列别杰夫在上海曾短暂受雇于互济投资公司（Mutual Investment Company）担任助理工程师。1934年至1936年间，他以同样身份受雇于结构工程顾问G. S. 鲍里索格列布斯基（Borisoglebsky）。

Becoming interested in the "nature cure" he undertook a course of study of its methods. Subsequently, he is reported to have obtained a diploma from a similar institution in New York. In April, 1935 Dr. BUIJS of the Shanghai Institute of Natural Therapeutics, established the "Nature Cure Institute" ( Iridologists, Osteopaths, Chiropractors, Swedish Masseurs, Specialists in Dietetics) at Room 222 Sasson House. Lebedeff is known to have been working as an assistant of Dr. Buijs until the latter's departure for Australia in June, 1936, after which a certain Mr. C. JANSSEN took charge of the institute. Following the departure of Mr. Janssen for Australia during the earlier part of 1937, Lebedeff has been conducting this institute with the offices at 209 Yuen Ming Yuen Road, Room 305. It is reported that a part of the equipment was left to him by Mr. Janssen.

Lebedeff is a member of the Russian Engineers Society in Shanghai. He is described as a cultured person and is reported to have a keen interest in theosophy and occult sciences. In July, 1937 he actively participated in the establishment of the Vegetarian Society of China. His wife, Mrs Margareta Iosifovna Lebedeff, is reported to have been acting for some time as a secretary to Mr. A.F. Knudsen, of the Theosophical Society, 153 Nanking Road.

Mr. and Mrs Lebedeff at present reside at 1562 Avenue Joffre, Apt. A-5.

经过长期患病且常规治疗无效后，他向四川路106号的“上海自然疗法研究所”（Shanghai Institute of Natural Therapeutics）寻求治疗。他对“自然疗法”产生兴趣，并开始研习其方法。据报，他随后获得了纽约一家类似机构颁发的文凭。1935年4月，上海自然疗法研究所的BUYS博士在沙逊大厦222室成立了“自然疗法研究所”（虹膜学家、整骨师、脊椎矫正师、瑞典按摩师、饮食专家）。已知列别杰夫一直作为Buys博士的助手工作，直到后者于1936年6月前往澳大利亚，此后由某位C. JANSSSEN先生负责该研究所。继Janssen先生于1937年初前往澳大利亚后，列别杰夫一直在圆明园路209号305室办公并主持该研究所。据报，部分设备由Janssen先生留给了他。

列别杰夫是上海俄国工程师学会的成员。他被描述为一个有教养的人，据报对神智学和神秘科学有浓厚兴趣。1937年7月，他积极参与了中国素食协会（Vegetarian Society of China）的成立工作。据报，他的妻子玛格丽塔·约瑟福夫娜·列别杰夫（Margareta Iosifovna Lebedeff）夫人曾在一段时间内担任南京路153号神智学会A.F. 克努森（Knudsen）先生的秘书。

列别杰夫夫妇目前居住在霞飞路1562号A-5公寓。

1. Dr. BUIJS N.,M.D., M.S.F., L.A.,N.A., naturalised Australian of Netherlands origin. "nature cure practitioner.

2. Gerritt JANSSEN. Netherlands subject, born on December 23,1910 at Doetrinchem,Netherlands. After five years' service in the Netherlands' colonial army in the Netherlands East Indies,he was honourably discharged in 1934,when he made his way to Shanghai where he obtained the post of stable-manager to the Shanghai Milk Supply Company. This position he held until the end of 1935,when he established himself as a "nature cure" practitioner at 221/222 Sassoon House in conjunction with Dr. Buijs. He was in possession of a certificate issued by the Smae Institute at Leatherhead (England) and one from the British Naturopathic College of London,which were given him after he had studied for eighteen months in his spare time and passed examinations held under the supervision of Dr. Buijs.
In September,1936 Janssen was warned by the local Netherlands Consular authorities to cease operating as a "nature cure practitioner". In his reply,he stated that the only work that he was carrying out was connected with the duties of a masseur pending Dr.Buijs' return to Shanghai.
In January,1937 a complaint was received by the Commissioner of Public Health,S.M.C., to the effect that Janssen ,owing to apparent ignorance in dealing with a case of communicable disease,unnecessarily exposed a number of persons to infection.
Neither Buijs,nor Janssen nor Lebedeff appear on the Register of medical practitioners etc. published by the Shanghai Municipal Council which constitutes the only official record of approved practitioners.
Nothing detrimental is known by this office regarding Mr. and Mrs Lebedeff.

D.C.( Special Branch)

1. N. BUYS博士，医学博士，理学硕士，文学士，北美学士，荷兰裔归化澳大利亚人。“自然疗法从业者。

2. Gerritt JANSSEN。荷兰籍臣民，1910年12月23日出生于荷兰多特里赫姆（Doetrinchem）。在荷属东印度的荷兰殖民军队服役五年后，他于1934年光荣退伍，随后前往上海，在那里获得了上海牛奶供应公司马房经理的职位。他一直担任此职直到1935年底，当时他与Buys博士合作，在沙逊大厦221/222室自立门户，成为“自然疗法”从业者。他持有英国莱瑟黑德（Leatherhead）同一研究所颁发的证书，以及伦敦英国自然疗法学院颁发的证书，这些证书是在他利用业余时间学习十八个月并通过在Buys博士监督下举行的考试后获得的。
1936年9月，Janssen受到当地荷兰领事当局的警告，要求停止以“自然疗法从业者”身份执业。他在回复中称，在Buys博士返回上海之前，他所进行的唯一工作与按摩师的职责有关。
1937年1月，工部局公共卫生处长收到一项投诉，称Janssen在处理一例传染病病例时，由于明显的无知，不必要地使多人暴露于感染风险之中。
Buys、Janssen和列别杰夫均未出现在上海公共租界工部局发布的执业医师等注册名录中，该名录是认可从业者的唯一官方记录。
本处未发现有关列别杰夫夫妇的任何不利信息。

D.C.（特务科）
（批：Dok 28/2）
G. Prokopieff
D. S. I.

THE CHINA PRESS, SUNDAY, JULY 11, 1937

Vegetarians
In Shanghai
Form Society

No More Fish, Flesh,
Fowl Is Battlecry Of
Organization

A united front against flesh, fish
and fowl was adopted at a meet-
ing held in the office of the
Shanghai Sanitarium, and Hos-
pital, Sassoon House, this week,
when the Vegetarian Society of
China was organized.

The decision to organize followed
a highly successful meatless dinner
party last week attended by many
leaders among local theosophists,
nature-curers, Brahmins and plain
vegetarians. The organization was
proposed by Mr. A. A. Lebedeff of
the Nature Cure Institute and an
organizing committee was named,
drawing final plans for the society
at a later meeting in the Sanita-
rium.

The President for the ensuing year
is Dr. Leslie H. Butka, 226 Sassoon
House, and the Vice-President, Mr.
A. Kwan, 418 Hart Road. Other
officers are: Messrs. Lebedeff and
Fu-tsu Chao, joint secretaries;
treasurer, Dr. Charles L. Dale;
directors, Y. T. Hu, R. McG.
Wright, A. Kalambi.

The immediate aim of the society
is to see that Shanghai is liberally
supplied with vegetarian cook
books. Eventually a vegetarian re-
staurant and perhaps even a hotel
are hoped for. Their slogan is:
"Health, Refinement, Economy and
Ethics."

Among those at the first meeting
was:
Dr. L. H. Butka; Dr. Charles
Dale; Mr. Kwan, sec. of the Pure
Karma League; Mr. Kalambi, of
the Dharmaloka Society; Mr. H. B.
Campbell, Pres. of the Shanghai
Theosophical Society; Mr. Y. T.
Hu, Editor of the Buddhist Daily
News; Mrs. Hu; Mr. and Mrs. A.
F. Knudsen of the Theosophical
Society in America; Mr. M. An-
thony, Mr. R. McG. Wright; Mr. A.
A. Lebedeff of the Nature-Cure
Institute; Mr. Fu-tsu Chao, sec. of
the Pure Karma League; Mr.
Krishnan of the local Brahmin
colony.

《字林西报》，1937年7月11日，星期日

素食者
在上海
组建协会

不再食用鱼、肉、
禽类是该组织的战斗口号

本周在沙逊大厦上海疗养院及医院办公室举行的一次会议上，中国素食协会正式成立，会上通过了对抗肉类、鱼类和禽类的统一战线。

组建该决定的背后，是上周一次非常成功的无肉晚宴，许多当地的神智学者、自然疗法倡导者、婆罗门和普通素食者领袖出席了晚宴。该组织由自然疗法研究所的A. A. 列别杰夫先生提议成立，并任命了一个筹备委员会，在随后于疗养院举行的会议上制定了协会的最终计划。

下一年度的主席是莱斯利·H·布特卡（Leslie H. Butka）博士，地址为沙逊大厦226室，副主席是关先生（Mr. A. Kwan），地址为哈同路418号。其他职员包括：列别杰夫先生和赵福祖（Fu-tsu Chao）先生，联合秘书；查尔斯·L·戴尔（Charles L. Dale）博士，财务；董事：胡愈之（Y. T. Hu）、R. McG. 赖特（Wright）、A. 卡拉姆比（Kalambi）。

协会的近期目标是确保上海有充足的素食食谱供应。最终希望能开设一家素食餐厅，甚至可能是一家酒店。他们的口号是：“健康、精致、节约和伦理。”

出席第一次会议的人员包括：
L. H. 布特卡博士；查尔斯·戴尔博士；关先生，纯业社（Pure Karma League）秘书；卡拉姆比先生，达摩洛卡社（Dharmaloka Society）成员；H. B. 坎贝尔（Campbell）先生，上海神智学会主席；胡愈之先生，《佛学日报》编辑；胡夫人；美国神智学会的A. F. 克努森先生及夫人；M. 安东尼（Anthony）先生；R. McG. 赖特先生；自然疗法研究所的A. A. 列别杰夫先生；赵福祖先生，纯业社秘书；以及当地婆罗门社区的克里希南（Krishnan）先生。

THE SHANGHAI SUNDAY TIMES, JULY 11, 1937

VEGETARIAN SOCIETY
ORGANIZED HERE

Various Nationalities
Participating In
Local Group

The Vegetarian Society of China,
an organization comprising various
nationalities, was formed at a meet-
ing held on Tuesday at the Kun-
dahling Vegetarian Restaurant, Park
Road. Mr. A. A. Lebedeff reviewed
the question of vegetarianism and
proposed to the group that a society
be organized to sponsor the move-
ment.

Among those attending were Dr.
L. H. Butka, Dr. Charles Dale, Mr.
Kwan, Mr. Kalambi, Mr. H. G.
Campbell, Mr. Y. T. Hu, Mrs. Hu,
Mr. and Mrs. A. F. Knudsen, Mr. M.
Anthony, Mr. R. M. Wright, Mr.
Lebedeff, Mr. Pu-tsu Chao and Mr.
Krishnan.

The form of organization provides
that the president and vice-president
shall be a foreigner and a Chinese,
alternating each year. There are
two secretaries for the two lan-
guages, English and Chinese.

Officers elected for the ensuing
year were Dr. L. H. Butka, presi-
dent, Mr. Kwan, vice-president,
Messrs. Lebedeff and Pu-tsu Chao,
joint secretaries, Dr. C. L. Dale,
treasurer, and Messrs. Y. T. Hu, Mr.
R. M. Wright and Mr. Kalambi,
directors.

《上海星期时报》，1937年7月11日

素食协会
在此成立

各国籍人士
参与本地团体

中国素食协会是一个包含各国籍人士的组织，于周二在公园路昆达林素食餐厅（Kundahling Vegetarian Restaurant）举行的一次会议上成立。A. A. 列别杰夫先生回顾了素食主义问题，并向小组提议组建一个协会来赞助这一运动。

出席者包括L. H. 布特卡博士、查尔斯·戴尔博士、关先生、卡拉姆比先生、H. G. 坎贝尔先生、胡愈之先生、胡夫人、A. F. 克努森先生及夫人、M. 安东尼先生、R. M. 赖特先生、列别杰夫先生、普祖赵（Pu-tsu Chao，音译，疑为赵福祖）先生和克里希南先生。

组织形式规定，主席和副主席由一名外国人和一名中国人担任，每年轮换。设有两名秘书，分别负责英语和中文。

当选的下一年度职员为：L. H. 布特卡博士，主席；关先生，副主席；列别杰夫先生和普祖赵先生，联合秘书；C. L. 戴尔博士，财务；以及胡愈之先生、R. M. 赖特先生和卡拉姆比先生，董事。
